note: Data-only trigger-routing fixtures (plugin-wide-6 / batch C4). There is no built-in eval runner; these cases are the fresh-session A/B baseline corpus recorded BEFORE the C1 description POV batch. Post-run user-verification artifact, not a merge gate.

evals.prompt: 分析需求：訂單匯出功能要動到 API、佇列 worker 和前端下載頁
evals.expected_behavior: Cross-module feature (≥2 interdependent modules): build the goal→requirement→design→test→task spec under .claude/analyze/.

evals.prompt: 展開規格，這個通知系統橫跨排程器、推播服務和使用者偏好設定
evals.expected_behavior: 展開規格 on a multi-module task: full spec expansion, then straight into the execution pipeline.

evals.prompt: 這個改動會碰到 parser 跟它下游的 renderer，要不要展開規格我不確定
evals.expected_behavior: Borderline two-layer case: per the Stage 0.B scope gate, err toward running /analyze and proceed with the spec.

evals.prompt: 這個函式改個回傳型別就好
evals.expected_behavior: Single-file change with no cross-module dependency: implement directly (or /think if a design choice remains).
Worth-doing judgment is /think Evaluation Mode, not spec expansion.

evals.prompt: 新的快取層怎麼設計比較好？
evals.expected_behavior: 怎麼設計 on a fresh idea needs a validated plan first — /think, not /analyze.
